speaker: john_heminges
text: Richard at two. You are in it. We have until eleven, and we have the rolls, and we do not have a new play in this room.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The comedy is at the lodging. It is not finished. Abel does not have it. He will not have it before I have played this king.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Lord Hastings. My liege. Madam. I have the three from Friday. I am not asking which of them is current. A reason will not help an entrance, and I have already refused one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave them. They are one morning's marks. They are not a new Richard. Do not mend the book. Mend nothing.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The wooing is still too big for a parlour if I give it the room. I will give it half. Thou wilt not ask me to whisper a king at two, when the yard is cold and the galleries are full of their own talk.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Half is what you gave it on Friday, and half was still too big. Give it half again. I am not rewriting the wooing between now and two.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Good. Three cues, left as they are. One king, at two. Tasso is at the Rose. None of you is going. I am not paying a man to be curious.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I am not curious. I am on the right lord if the cues stay put. Friday I was on the wrong one twice. I have said so. I will not say it a third time for luck.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou art hoarse still, a little. Phillips heard it on Friday and wanted Cowley for Egeon. Thou wouldst not. Today is not Egeon.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Today is not Egeon. The fever is gone. I am in Richard at two. Cowley is not covering a well man.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I did not come to cover you. I came to hear that the three words are still the three words. They are. I can go and be cold in the yard with a clear mind.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Edith's eight shillings is still owing till Lady Day. I am not collecting it in a rehearsal, and I am not pretending the Queen's twenty pound will pay it. That twenty pound is not had, and it is not yours.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I know both sums. Neither of them is this morning. The book I owe Abel is a comedy, and it is not in my hand yet.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then go and finish it when we are done with the king. Do not finish it over my shoulder in this parlour. I have a wooing to keep half-sized, and I will not have thy last line in my ear while I do it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not. Before dinner, at the lodging. After the play, Abel may have it, if the door is shut. Not before.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: And if a man asks me at the door what the new comedy is, I will tell him I was on Lord Hastings. That is the truth of this morning. It is a dull truth, and it will survive being repeated.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Dull is what I want from a rehearsal of a play we know. Thou art not to be interesting before two. Interesting is how a king drops a line.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will be dull. The three words stay. The wooing stays at half. I am not giving you a new cue to be kind to my throat. My throat is a throat again.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Phillips is not in this room to offer Cowley your afternoon. I am glad of it. One argument of that kind was enough for the week you were ill.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I have Egeon in my head from Saturday, and I am not offering it. You were in your bed. Today you are on your feet. A reason will still not help an entrance, and I am not collecting reasons.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep Saturday's word for Saturday's play. Today is Richard. I will see you in the yard at two, and not before, if you can help it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Two. I will be large enough then, and no larger than the yard can bear. Do not bring the lodging into the tiring-house.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I will be in the yard, not in your ear. Lord Hastings at the third time of asking is still Lord Hastings. I am done.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Done is the right size. Eleven, and then the play, and then the lodging if I am quick. Not this parlour.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Eleven. The rolls go back in the basket. No one copies a part of a comedy that is not ended. I will say that once, and I will not say it to Kemp until there is a book to refuse him.
